result.baseline: Use the unchanged active Execute prompt. Build a precommitted versioned three-scenario/two-configuration synthetic benchmark over isolated checkpoint copies: stale Work heartbeat before successor freeze, moved authoritative state/main binding, and newer inbox revision at dispatch. For each scenario, compare the protected configuration with a fail-open control disabling only that scenario guard. Record byte-stable traces, identities, counters, rejection and repair reasons, and replay digests. Protected runs must reject stale authority before effects, preserve the exact request, repair only the concrete stop cause, and resume exactly once with zero stale commits, duplicate responses or successors, fence changes, inbox bypasses, or live-authority writes.

cost_dimensions.failure_risk: Fail closed on live-authority touch, identity recreation, stale commit, duplicate effect, non-informative control, widened claim, or publication mismatch.
cost_dimensions.latency: Bounded to three scenarios, two configurations, deterministic replay, focused tests, and protected publication.
cost_dimensions.quality: Require precommitted outcomes, exact request preservation, one-guard controls, deterministic digests, unique successor after repair, and guard-to-prevented-behavior mapping.
cost_dimensions.token: No inferred model-token or capability claim.
cost_dimensions.tool: Repository runtime, isolated fixtures, tests, GitHub Actions, expected-head merge, and exact readback only.

result.rollback: If a fixture touches live authority, protected execution accepts stale context, repair recreates identity, a control changes more than one guard or is non-informative, replay diverges, or publication/readback fails: preserve failure artifacts, make no Candidate or route change, reject the unit, repair the concrete cause, and rerun only the invalid bounded scenario.
